```{r}
function_AR_MV<-function(coeurs,list_variable,repertory){
  l_Orig<-list()
  l_Transf<-list()
  for(nom_variable in list_variable){
    lien_donnees<-paste0(repertory,"Data_",nom_variable,".csv")
    Donnes<-read.csv(file=lien_donnees)[,2:38]
    colnames(Donnes)<-c(1:37)
    rownames(Donnes)<-c(1:nrow(Donnes))
    l_Orig[[nom_variable]]<-Donnes
    N<-nrow(Donnes)
    l_Transf[[nom_variable]]<-matrix(data =NA,
                                     ncol=ncol(Donnes),
                                     nrow=nrow(Donnes)-1)
  }
  d<-length(list_variable)
  p<-d+2
  D<-ncol(Donnes)
  MATRIX_Mod_VAR<-matrix(NA,nrow=D*p,ncol=d)
  for(t in c(1:D)){
    Data_time_t<-matrix(NA,nrow = nrow(Donnes),
                        ncol=length(list_variable))
    for(Z in c(1:d)){
      NAMEV<-list_variable[[Z]]
      Data_time_t[,Z]<-l_Orig[[NAMEV]][,t]
    }
    par(mfrow=c(1,2))
    png(filename=paste0("whitening_MV/corr_intervar_",
                        list_variable[1],"_",
                        list_variable[2],".png"))
    Objet_ccf<-ccf(x = Data_time_t[,1],y = Data_time_t[,2],
        type="correlation",
        plot = FALSE,
        lag.max = 1000,main= " ")
    plot(Objet_ccf,ylim=c(-1,1))
    dev.off()
    ### VAR(1) model.
    beg<-(t-1)*p+1
    end<-t*p
    Indexes_VAR_t<-c(beg:end)
    model_VAR<-vars::VAR(Data_time_t,p = 1,type = "both")
    Coefficients<-coef(model_VAR)
    Coefficients_matrix<-sapply(Coefficients,FUN=function(x){
      return(x[,1])})
    MATRIX_Mod_VAR[Indexes_VAR_t,]<-Coefficients_matrix
    Resid_VAR<-residuals(model_VAR)
    png(filename=paste0("whitening_MV/corr_intervar_",
                        list_variable[1],"_",
                        list_variable[2],"residuals.png"))
    Objet_cff2<-ccf(x = Resid_VAR[,1],y = Resid_VAR[,2],
        type="correlation",
        plot = FALSE,
        lag.max =  1000,main=" ")
    plot(Objet_cff2,ylim=c(-1,1))
    dev.off()
    par(mfrow=c(1,1))
    
    par(mfrow=c(1,d))
    for(Z in c(1:d)){
      NAMEV<-list_variable[[Z]]
      l_Transf[[NAMEV]][,t]<-Resid_VAR[,Z]
    }
    par(mfrow=c(1,1))
    
  }
  ### Export VAR model
  colnames(MATRIX_Mod_VAR)<-lNAME
  write.csv(file="whitening_MV/VAR_model.csv",
            x = MATRIX_Mod_VAR)
  
  ### Export residuals
  for(Z in c(1:d)){
    NAMEV<-list_variable[[Z]]
    Data_toexport_Z<-l_Transf[[NAMEV]]
    write.csv(file = paste0(
      "residuals_MV/",NAMEV,
      "_residuals.csv"
    ),x=Data_toexport_Z)
  }
  return(model_VAR)
}
```
